review.method: Independent source comparison of rows 481-560, adjacent full-corpus context 477-480/561-564, and additional training context 657-660. Conditions, inequality boundaries, branch direction, subroutine behavior and own/enemy subjects verified.
uncertainties: Ground Contact at rows 540/546 is supported by condition descriptions 477/492 despite the labels literally referring to landing; retain a grounded-state interpretation pending native behavior tests.
Option Count Check at row 531 preserves the omitted remaining quantity without inventing ammunition or charges.
Row 537 is delete-action help rendered as the corresponding UI instruction; actual invocation remains untested.

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256.

notes.482: Marked preserves the game's targeting action rather than inventing an enemy identity or gender.
notes.496: The source condition is strictly exceeding the set time, unlike altitude comparison rows 478/493 which explicitly include equality.
notes.498: Counter follows the blue branch each time the configured count of chip visits is reached, not just once on the first visit.
notes.499: Stopwatch condition is strictly exceeding the configured time.
notes.500: The program, rather than the player or Marionette movement alone, pauses for the specified time.
notes.501: The omitted subject is restored as this chip from the programming-help context.
notes.504: Return resumes after a temporary call to a color label. Preserve the distinction from unconditional Skip at row 503.
notes.510: Outer wall means the arena boundary, not every obstacle wall.
notes.520: Movement is stopped first if the unit is already moving; this chip does not simply ignore a repeated movement command.
notes.531: Option Count Check retains the remaining-count meaning without inventing ammunition, charge or uses.
notes.532: Enemy Search scans the specified direction but marks only an enemy directly ahead; both conditions are retained.
notes.537: Deletion is a UI instruction and retains the source's direct action wording.
notes.539: Rows 539-543 Unit labels refer to your own unit, as confirmed by the corresponding conditional help rows 477-481/518-519.
notes.540: Ground Contact retains the source grounded-state check rather than assuming it fires only on the instant of landing.
notes.543: A shared description names both the own-unit Hit Point Check and Energy Check chips; preserve both.
notes.544: Enemy Mark Check relates to the enemy's mark targeting your unit, confirmed by row 482; do not conflate it with your own Mark Check at row 538.
notes.546: Enemy Ground Contact denotes the grounded-state condition, confirmed by row 492.
notes.555: No-Op is a conventional label for a chip that performs no action, confirmed by row 501. Chip terminology remains subject to corpus-wide glossary normalization.
